title: PUA Config
description: User configuration for PUA skill plugin (~/.pua/config.json)

always_on.description: Whether PUA hooks are always active (false = /pua:off)

offline.description: Offline mode — disable all network calls (heartbeat, feedback upload)

review_net_threshold.description: Churn gate: net changed lines (added+removed) that trigger mandatory review (churn-gate.sh)

review_gross_threshold.description: Churn gate: gross churned lines (every touched line, including re-edits) that trigger mandatory review (churn-gate.sh)
